source_title: Never Run Out of Ports Again With This Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Charging Station, on Sale for Black Friday
source_excerpt:
You can never have too many charging ports.
Looking for a desktop charging station that has enough ports and delivers enough power to satisfy all of your needs? Amazon has discounted the hefty Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Desktop Charging Station to just $59.42 after 34% off coupon code " DJK4D88Z ", dropping it to the lowest price of the year. It features both USB Type-A and Type-C ports and can deliver as much as 100W of power per port and 252W of total simultaneous power output.
34% Off the Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Desktop Charger
Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Desktop Charger with Power Delivery 3.0 and PPS
The Sabrent charging station features eight total ports: four USB Type-A ports and four USB Type-C ports. Each Type-C port can deliver up to 100W and each Type-A port can deliver up to 18W. All six ports can be used simultaneously, however the maximum output caps at 252W (126W max for USB-C and 126W max for USB-A). The 100W port is powerful enough to charge laptops, tablets, phones, and power hungry gaming handhelds like the Xbox Ally X20, Steam Deck, or Lenovo Legion Go 2. The 18W ports can handle lower power electronics including your Apple accessories, mice, headsets, controllers, and other PC peripherals. The charging station also has an LCD status display that monitors real-time power draw per port. I've owned a Sabrent USB charging station for nearly six years now and it still works well.
